title: Blink vs Emergent: Which AI App Builder Should You Use in 2026?
summary: Blink and Emergent both promise to build full apps from prompts. Honest head-to-head: speed, full-stack completeness, pricing, and which one actually ships to production.
body_markdown: Emergent Standard gives 100 credits at $20/month; complex projects and debugging loops can exhaust these. Pro Ultra ($200/month) gives 750 credits for more headroom. Multiple users document credit burn on debugging as the primary frustration.[Blink](https://blink.new/) plans also include monthly credits, but the database, auth, and hosting come with the plan — no external service bills on top.
